Gainward GeForce RTX™ 4080 SUPER Phoenix
Gainward GeForce RTX™ 4080 SUPER Phoenix
Overview
Download
Gallery
Gamers Reborn. Fly Your Gaming DNA.
The GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER Phoenix with DLSS 3 is an excellent alternative to the stealthy black Phantom lineup. The large ARGB lighting capacity on the Phoenix suits the users who prefer a more lively gaming style.
Utilizing the whole new Cyclone Fan and Diffuser Fins, the thermal design on the GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER Phoenix ensures steady airflow, efficient heat dissipation and low acoustic level even under heavy-loading gaming environment.
Powered by NVIDIA DLSS 3, ultra-efficient Ada Lovelace architecture, and full ray tracing.

Auto Sync
Offering great compatibility, the Auto Sync technology enables the Gainward graphics card to shine in unity with other ARGB-supported PC parts. Just plug a single cable in, and the ARGB lighting can be synchronized at once without software settings.
Cyclone Fan
The wing tip on fan tail converges the air current, collecting maximized airflow into the cooling system. The claw marks engraved on the blade backs further smooth the airflow and lead the air to the heat sink steadily.
Diffuser Fins
The angular fins largely extend the contact surface of the air and the fins, enabling the air current to transmit in the steadiest way.
Classy Metal Backplate
Enjoy the premium airflow performance while keeping aesthetics. The backplate comes with precise cutouts for optimal air venting. The artistic carves and geometric pattern design entitle the backplate as an art piece, reflecting the high-class lifestyle of its user.
Mega Copper Base
The Mega Copper Base produced with anti-oxidation process covers both the GPU and DRAM for effective heat absorbing.
Ultra-Dense Protection Plate
The Ultra-Dense Protection Plate offers extra protection to the graphics card, keeping the board in the sturdy shape.
Two Ball Bearing
Two-ball bearing to bring longer life span for the fan.
• IP5X dust resistant technology
• Lower fan vibration
• 2X Prolonged fan life expectancy
ARGB Lighting
Addressable RGB allows gamers to customize each LED color.
You can personalize the lighting effects with GAINWARD Expertool Utility
ZERO RPM FAN
The fans stay idle during light tasks for silent operation, activating only when necessary. This ensures quiet efficiency during low-load tasks and powerful cooling when performance demands rise.
NVIDIA DLSS 3
DLSS is a revolutionary breakthrough in AI graphics that multiplies performance. Powered by the new fourth-gen Tensor Cores and Optical Flow Accelerator on GeForce RTX 40 Series GPUs, DLSS 3 uses AI to create additional frames and improve image quality.
NVIDIA Reflex
Built to optimize and measure system latency, Reflex provides faster target acquisition, quicker reaction times, and the best aim precision for competitive games.
Ray Tracing
The Ada architecture unleashes the full glory of ray tracing, which simulates how light behaves in the real world. With the power of RTX 40 Series and third-gen RT Cores, you can experience incredibly detailed virtual worlds like never before.
NVIDIA G-SYNC®
Get smooth, tear-free gameplay at high refresh rates, plus HDR and more. This is the ultimate gaming display and the go-to equipment for enthusiast gamers.
